notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is now available
notes.notes:
Hello,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131304/ebc7437275104667c5f7cda042451c2cb6e13705.gif

Update 1.0.2 is now available, bringing several improvements and fixes. Future updates will further enhance performance and gameplay.  

Changes in Update 1.0.2 (changelog):

 Performance improvements for all devices (5%-50% more FPS).  
 Optimizations in GPU memory management.  
 Fixes to the water system.  
 Translation corrections for certain languages (English, Polish).  
 Adjustments to some objects (colliders, etc.).  
 Resolved an issue for players from Korea, Japan, China, etc., who had to click "submit score" to view their time. The time is now displayed automatically after completing the game.  
 Additional minor fixes are included.

Updated platforms:
- Windows 32-bit  
- Windows 64-bit  
- Linux 64-bit  
- Mac 64-bit (Intel 64 bity and Apple Silicon)

Thank You for support, as a one-person studio, I appreciate any help. The next update will also include an updated demo (so that the demo version does not differ too much from the main version). Thank You.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3140930/The_Liminal_Dimension_Demo/
